Body.Content:
The Approvals Agent in Dynamics 365 Project Operations uses AI to perform an initial review of submitted time, expense, and material entries against policy documents written in natural language. It classifies entries as Ready for approval or Needs review, helping project managers prioritize entries that require attention.

Organizations can choose between two operating modes. In Classify mode, approvers review the agent’s classifications and manually approve entries. In Classify and auto approve mode, entries classified as Ready for approval are automatically processed for approval, while entries classified as Needs review remain available for human review.

Administrators can configure organization-wide policies and project-specific policies for each entry type. A project-specific policy takes precedence over the corresponding organization-wide policy. Project-level controls determine which projects use the agent, with a configurable default for new projects.

Approvers can review classified entries, approve or reject them, or return them to the agent for reevaluation after a policy update. If no applicable policy document exists for an entry type, the agent does not classify those entries.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/approvals/approvals-agent-intro

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: April CY2025
